description: An international consortium of academic bio labs and independent AI researchers announces the discovery of a previously unknown class of self-replicating RNA-based nanocarriers, designed entirely by an open-weight model and synthesised via distributed lab networks. The system was not intended as a weapon, but its delivery mechanism shows high tissue specificity and immune evasion. The paper is immediately red-flagged and withdrawn, but the design spreads through preprint mirrors and encrypted channels. The incident bypasses traditional biosecurity checkpoints and demonstrates that open capability at 58.0 is now sufficient to generate credible dual-use biological systems.
